help.introDescription: School Management is a desktop application for running a tutoring school — manage students, teachers, courses, classes, enrollments and payments. All data is stored locally and securely on your device, so it works fully offline. Use the options below to replay the guided tour, explore the source code, or get in touch.

dashboard.kpiContent: Get a quick overview of your school with important metrics such as students, teachers, courses, and payments.
dashboard.revenueEnrollmentContent: Compare monthly revenue and student enrollment to understand how your school's performance has changed over the past six months.
dashboard.courseEnrollmentContent: View enrollment trends across your courses and see how many students are enrolled in each course.
dashboard.todayClassesContent: Keep track of today's scheduled classes, including the class time, course, and teacher.
dashboard.recentEnrollmentsContent: See the latest student enrollments and quickly keep up with new registrations.
dashboard.recentPaymentsContent: Review the most recent payments and monitor your school's latest payment activity.
dashboard.outstandingPaymentsContent: Track pending payments and see the total amount that is still outstanding.

classes.courseFilterContent: Filter classes by selecting a specific course.
classes.dateRangeContent: Select a start date, an end date, or both to filter classes. If both dates are selected, the end date must be after the start date. Example: 01 Jan 2026 – 15 Jan 2026.
classes.timeRangeContent: Select a start time, an end time, or both to filter classes. If both times are selected, the end time must be after the start time. Example: 10:00 AM – 02:00 PM.
classes.priceRangeContent: Select a minimum price, a maximum price, or both to filter classes. If both prices are selected, the minimum price must be less than the maximum price. Example: $10 - $50.
classes.resetFiltersContent: Clear all selected filters and reset the class list to its default view.
classes.applyFiltersContent: Apply the selected filters to quickly find classes that match your criteria.
classes.viewChangeContent: Change the view of the classes data between list and grid.
classes.exportCsvContent: Export class data to CSV for easy analysis and reporting.
classes.createClassContent: Create a new class by providing the necessary information.

classesCreate.selectCourseContent: Choose the course for this class.
classesCreate.selectTeacherContent: Choose the teacher who will teach this class.
classesCreate.selectDayContent: Choose the day of the week when this class will be held.
classesCreate.selectStartDateContent: Choose the date when this class will begin. The start date must be in the future.
classesCreate.selectStartTimeContent: Choose the class start time. It must be earlier than the end time. Note: You cannot create a class during a time when the selected teacher is already teaching another class.
classesCreate.selectEndTimeContent: Choose the class end time. It must be later than the start time. Note: You cannot create a class during a time when the selected teacher is already teaching another class.
classesCreate.addDescriptionContent: Add helpful details about the class, such as notes, a Telegram group link, or a Google Classroom link.

classesDetails.deleteClassContent: Delete this class. A class cannot be deleted if students are currently enrolled.

coursesDetails.deleteCourseContent: Delete this course. If the course is assigned to existing classes, they will not be permanently deleted. Instead, their status will be changed to inactive.

coursesDetails.courseClassesContent: View all classes assigned to this course.
coursesDetails.courseTimetableContent: View the course's class schedule and timetable.

teachersDetails.deleteTeacherContent: Delete this teacher. If the teacher is assigned to existing classes, they will not be permanently deleted. Instead, their status will be changed to inactive.

teachersDetails.teacherTimetableContent: View the teacher's class schedule and timetable.
